contract.search: 6 chains, 30 rounds each; 24 exact multiple-try proposals per round; first 10 greedy recovery rounds then 20 long fine-cooling rounds. Ranking-only ridge ensemble surrogate, group crossover and regrouping proposals; no far restart during a chain.

proposalModel.role: ordering candidates only; every reported score is a full exact CKT v5.2 score
proposalModel.uncertainty: disagreement between three weighted ridge models; not a calibrated confidence interval

completeFinalRingAudit.scope: complete legal single-final swaps, whole-key final-group swaps and single-final key moves under the fixed search policy; not all double/triple changes or every policy optimized neighbor
